TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT c.curr_cntrct_vndr_nm AS curr_cntrct_vndr_nm, c.curr_opco_nm AS curr_opco_nm, UPPER(c.parnt_cntrct_nm) AS parnt_cntrct_nm FROM feladm.fel_contract_dim c INNER JOIN ( SELECT d.parnt_cntrct_nm AS pname, MAX(d.cntrct_expr_dt) AS max_date FROM feladm.fel_contract_dim d WHERE UPPER(TRIM(d.system_nm)) = 'COMTRAC' GROUP BY d.parnt_cntrct_nm) m ON c.parnt_cntrct_nm = m.pname AND c.cntrct_expr_dt = m.max_date WHERE UPPER(TRIM(c.system_nm)) = 'COMTRAC'
